title: Challenges and Support Plans for Students Graduating from Hospitality, Aviation and Aerospace Courses in 2021
what_it_is: Challenges and Support Plans for Students Graduating from Hospitality, Aviation and Aerospace Courses in 2021

sections.label: Support for hospitality aviation graduates
sections.summary: Government worked with IHLs and industry to support graduates, and extended the SGUnited Traineeships Programme to March 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Government has been working closely with the Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs) and the industry to support graduates entering the workforce since last year, including around 5,000 graduates from full-time courses related to hospitality, aviation and aerospace from the IHLs who graduated between December 2020 and September 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The SGUnited Traineeships Programme was introduced last year to provide fresh graduates with industry experience and the opportunity to convert their training to a full-time job.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Over 10,200 graduates have benefited from this, including some from the hospitality, aviation and aerospace courses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOM and Workforce Singapore (WSG) have extended this programme until March 2022.

sections.label: Hospitality aviation graduate employment rates
sections.summary: About nine in 10 such 2020 graduates were employed within six months, similar to overall Class of 2020 and 2019 rates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: About nine in 10 graduates from courses related to hospitality, aviation and aerospace who entered the labour market in 2020 were employed within six months after their final examinations or one year after completion of full-time National Service.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Of those who were employed, about one in 10 were on-boarded as trainees under the SGUnited Traineeships Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This is similar to the overall employment rate for Class of 2020 graduates across all IHL courses, as well as those who graduated in 2019, before the onset of COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to monitor the graduate employment situation closely as the economy recovers and prepare our graduates well in starting their first careers.
